Definition: third person singular present indicative active of G568 used impersonally; it is sufficient:--it is enough.
BiblicalUsage: It is enough — Jesus' words to the sleeping disciples in Gethsemane: sleep on now, take your rest, it is enough, the hour is come. The word is a single, tired full stop, and it appears only here.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even in Gethsemane, Jesus sets the limit: the hour has come, the waiting is over, and what must be faced will be faced.
